name: Go Corner Market · Praya detail pass
description: A chamfered corner market with a diagonal glazed entrance, stepped timber canopy and an offset rear service wing. The cut corner becomes a pocket plaza; a recessed delivery court separates the stocked retail hall from refrigeration plant and loading. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.

components.role: Pedestrian frontage and separate side loading lane
Pocket seating terrace, cycle stands and planted street edge
Diagonal arrival plaza, seating and planting
Chamfered glazed hall and offset service-wing shell
Open check-in portals with decorative scanner pedestals
Coffee equipment, preparation worktop and sheltered snack bar
Three stocked gondolas with contrasting products and end displays
Chilled-food wall repositioned beyond the diagonal entrance
Offset service wing, stock pallets and rear loading passage
Stepped timber entrance canopy following the chamfer
Rear plant enclosure and retail rooflights
